cases.expected_output: Explain that a heat pump transfers heat rather than generating it by combustion, that it can provide heating and cooling, and that actual performance depends on equipment and conditions. Keep the explanation useful to homeowners and avoid guaranteed savings claims.

research.summary: An air-source heat pump moves heat between a home and the outdoor air. It can provide heating and cooling. Performance depends on equipment and operating conditions.

sources.title: Heat Pump Systems
sources.content: Heat pumps move heat from one place to another. Air-source heat pumps can provide heating and cooling. Performance varies with the system and conditions.

cases.topic: Benefits and limits of urban tree canopies
cases.audience: City residents interested in local climate adaptation
cases.expected_output: Describe how urban trees can provide shade and support cooler local conditions, while explaining that benefits depend on species, placement, maintenance, and local context. Do not promise a specific temperature or health outcome.

research.topic: Benefits and limits of urban tree canopies
research.summary: Urban trees provide shade and can reduce heat exposure. Outcomes vary by location, canopy coverage, tree species, and maintenance.

sources.title: Using Trees and Vegetation to Reduce Heat Islands
sources.content: Trees and vegetation provide shade and can reduce heat island effects. The amount of cooling depends on local conditions, vegetation, and placement.
